summary: Kennametal Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $300M public offer and sale of 5.800% Senior Notes due 2036, alongside a concurrent tender offer for its 4.625% Senior Notes due 2028. Net proceeds of ~$296M after underwriter discount and expenses will fund the purchase of tendered 2028 Notes, with excess for general corporate purposes. The issuance was made under a February 2012 Base Indenture as supplemented; the underwriting agreement involves BofA Securities, BNP Paribas, and PNC Capital Markets. This is a routine debt refinancing without special-situation characteristics.
